Name: Qmi's Void Cat
Author: Qmina
Description:
[color=#f6b26b][size=4][b]Only works with SV 1.6![/b][/size][/color]

I originally just made this for myself and my friend who are both obsessed with void cats, but if there's someone else out there who would like to use this mod I decided to post it here :D



[b][size=4][color=#f6b26b]How to activate:
[/color]
[/size][/b]> Unzip the file and put it into your mod folder ( Stardew Valley -> Mods )
> Make sure you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]installed
> Select the black cat as your pet preference in-game and it will automatically change into the void sprite! Enjoy <3


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZFoQWcw.png[/img]

Downloads.Description: Changes the normal black cat into Qmi's void cat
